en: Create a Lovegobuy account using Register. Open a find here and review the source listing, product ID and photos. Continue to Lovegobuy, or paste the original Weidian link into its search bar.
Read the seller description and check the size chart. Select the colour, size and quantity you want, then add the item to your cart or use Buy Now. Record important requirements in the order remarks.

Review the selected variant, item price and delivery from the seller to the Chinese warehouse. Select an available payment method and confirm the first payment. This payment does not cover international shipping.

Lovegobuy arranges the purchase and the seller sends the goods to its warehouse. Follow the order status in your account and respond if the agent asks for additional information. Purchase and seller dispatch times can vary.

After stock-in, open User Center → Warehouse and examine your own item photos. Compare the size label, colour, quantity and visible condition with your order. Raise problems or request clearer detail photos before submitting the item for overseas shipping.

Select the stored items you want to send together and submit them for delivery. Enter your delivery details carefully. Compare the eligible routes, packaging options, weight and parcel dimensions before choosing a service.

Check the freight amount shown for the selected route and review any optional services. Pay the international shipping charge through Lovegobuy. Confirm any later adjustment shown in your account; an estimate is not the final delivered cost.

Lovegobuy consolidates, packs and dispatches your parcel. Follow the status and tracking updates on the Parcels page. Keep your order and parcel records, and contact platform support if a shipment needs attention.
zh: 使用导航栏注册按钮创建 Lovegobuy 账户。在本站查看商品详情、微店 ID 和图片后，进入 Lovegobuy 对应商品页；也可将微店原链接粘贴到平台搜索栏。
阅读卖家说明与尺码表，选择颜色、尺码和数量，再加入购物车或立即购买。需要特别确认的要求请写入订单备注。
核对款式、商品价和卖家寄往中国仓库的境内运费，选择可用付款方式完成第一阶段付款。此阶段不包含国际运费。
Lovegobuy 安排采购，卖家随后发货至仓库。在账户订单中查看状态，如采购人员需要补充信息请及时回复；采购与卖家发货时间可能不同。
商品入库后，进入用户中心的仓库页面查看自己订单的照片。核对尺码标签、颜色、数量和外观，发现问题或图片不清楚时，先联系支持再提交国际运输。
选择需要一起寄出的入仓商品并提交配送，准确填写地址。比较可用线路、包装选项、重量和包裹体积后再选择运输服务。
核对所选线路的运费以及附加服务，通过 Lovegobuy 支付。若账户显示后续补差或调整，需要再次确认；预估金额并非最终送达成本。
平台合并、打包并寄出包裹。在包裹页面查看状态和物流更新，保留订单与包裹记录，运输出现问题时联系平台支持。
